description: Implementation of string formatting argument handling functions for the Abseil library, including conversion of various data types to string representations for formatting.

classes.name: IntDigits
classes.description: Helper class for converting integers to string representations in various formats (decimal, octal, hex).

methods.name: ReducePadding
methods.description: Adjusts capacity based on string size or number of characters, ensuring non-negative capacity.

methods.name: PrintAsOct
methods.description: Converts an unsigned integer to its octal string representation.

methods.name: PrintAsDec
methods.description: Converts an integer to its decimal string representation.

methods.name: PrintAsHexLower
methods.description: Converts an unsigned integer to its lowercase hexadecimal string representation.

methods.name: PrintAsHexUpper
methods.description: Converts an unsigned integer to its uppercase hexadecimal string representation.

methods.name: with_neg_and_zero
methods.description: Returns the string representation including sign if negative, or zero.

methods.name: without_neg_or_zero
methods.description: Returns the string representation without sign or zero.

methods.name: is_negative
methods.description: Checks if the number is negative based on the sign in the string.
